title: Luce Memorial Chapel

buildingCutout.basis: The native footprint of the four curved chapel shells.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation at the eastern approach directly in front of the broad glazed entrance.

identities.name: Luce Memorial Chapel
identities.address: 1727 Taiwan Boulevard Section 4, Xitun District, Taichung, Taiwan

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped hexagonal shell perimeter, multiple verified Qualla exterior angles, and published university measurements for each pair of shells.

note: Tunghai University records four structurally separate double-curved surfaces. The two altar shells reach 19.20 metres and the two nave shells 17.15 metres. Crest and end gaps are glazed.
